# vercel_shareable_link (Data Source)

Reads an existing shareable link for a Vercel alias without creating or revoking it. Ordinary deployment URLs without an alias record are not supported. The secret and URL are sensitive but are stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vercel_shareable_link" "preview" {
  alias = "my-project-git-staging.vercel.app"
}

output "preview_share_url" {
  value     = data.vercel_shareable_link.preview.url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) The alias hostname, without a scheme or path.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) The team ID. Defaults to the team configured in the provider.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the link has not expired, as of the last read.
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time in Unix milliseconds.
- `created_by` (String) The creator's ID.
- `expires_at` (Number) Expiry time in Unix seconds, or null for no expiry.
- `id` (String) The non-secret ID of the alias owning the link.
- `project_id` (String) The project owning the alias.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The bearer secret. Stored in Terraform state.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The HTTPS shareable URL, including the secret. Stored in Terraform state.
